/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.

  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.

  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
  callee's signature before expansion loses it.

  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Rule
open Semantics

/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)

/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])

/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)

/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
    | .violated => R.f
    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩

/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
  !r.id.isEmpty &&
  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))

/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Static check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)

/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k

/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
    match a with
    | .var v =>
      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
      | some (_, vs) =>
        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
        | none => .ok (.v 0)
    | .lit l =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.s l)
    | .nat n =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.n n)

private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
  | .malformed w => some w
  | .parameterMissing w => some w
  | _ => none

private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }

/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
    that reached the check unfilled. -/
private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]

private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"

/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
  | .param _ => []
  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]

mutual
  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .measure a args =>
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
        | .ok _ => []
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b

  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []
    | .intent _ who target =>
      [(who, EntityKind.track, "road user"), (target, EntityKind.region, "region")].flatMap fun (a, want, what) =>
        match a with
        | .var v => if scope.binds v want then [] else [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} `{v}` is not a bound {repr want}"]
        | _ => [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} is a variable"]
    | .same a b => [a, b].flatMap fun arg => match arg with
      | .var v => if scope.any (·.1 == v) then [] else [s!"{where_}: variable `{v}` is not bound"]
      | _ => [s!"{where_}: `same` compares two bound variables"]
    | .atom name args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ name ps
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts name) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds =>
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then inner     -- membership is the reading's; `checkReading` holds the word
        else match evalAtomE emptyScene name ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: atom `{name}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .cmp l _ r => checkTerm scope where_ l ++ checkTerm scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ | .within m d subj φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => checkFormula scope where_ e ++ checkFormula scope where_ sφ
    | .rises φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .definedWhen p φ => checkFormula scope where_ p ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalB concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .rule _ map | .ruleApplies _ map => map.flatMap fun (_, outer) =>
        if scope.binds outer .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: composition maps to `{outer}`, not a bound track"]
    | .existsRegion k v φ | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "region" (fun s => (StructureKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice k v φ | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "device" (fun s => (DeviceKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ

  partial def windowErrors (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subj : String) : List String :=
    (if m = .path && !scope.binds subj .track then [s!"{where_}: window subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"] else []) ++
    (if Term.isConstant d then [] else [s!"{where_}: window length is not a constant term"])
end

-- A declared intention read ahead of the judged observation: an `intent` leaf, or a composed
-- rule that reads one, within the scope of a future operator, in a formula or a term.
mutual
  partial def futureTerm (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => futureTerm reads fut g ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | .neg a | .abs a => futureTerm reads fut a
    | .cond φ a b => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | _ => []
  partial def futureReads (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .intent id _ _ => if fut then [s!"declared intention `{id}` is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if fut && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads a declared intention and is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .cmp l _ r => futureTerm reads fut l ++ futureTerm reads fut r
    | .always φ | .eventually φ => futureReads reads true φ
    | .until φ ψ => futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .within _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .not φ | .rises φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut ψ ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => futureReads reads fut e ++ futureReads reads fut sφ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`), whose zero is the start of the
-- recording, read where it can decide a search into the past: inside an operand of `since`, of
-- `atLast` or of `count`, inside the formula of `sinceRise`, the onset of `headingSince` or the
-- formula of `rises`, directly or through a composed rule that reads it. Everywhere else it is
-- ordinary arithmetic; path windows and `distanceWhile` measure differences and are never this.
mutual
  partial def pathTerm (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .measure "kin_path_length" _ =>
      if back then ["the distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`) is read inside a search into the past (`since`, `sinceRise`, `atLast`, `count` or `rises`); the start of a recording is no event of a road user's history"] else []
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .sinceRise φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => pathTerm reads back g ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | .neg a | .abs a => pathTerm reads back a
    | .cond φ a b => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | _ => []
  partial def pathReads (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if back && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads the distance travelled since the trace began and is composed inside a search into the past"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .cmp l _ r => pathTerm reads back l ++ pathTerm reads back r
    | .since φ ψ => pathReads reads true φ ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads true ψ ++ pathReads reads true φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => pathReads reads true e ++ pathReads reads true sφ
    | .rises φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- Whether a rule, or a rule it composes, reads `kin_path_length` anywhere. -/
def readsPath (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  (closure rules r).any fun x => x.formulas.any fun φ => !(pathReads (fun _ => false) true φ).isEmpty

/-- Every defect a rule has before any trace; empty for a rule the evaluator will never report
    `malformed` or `unboundVariable` on: an empty id; no binder, or one unnamed or named twice;
    an assumption or intention read but not declared, or an intention id ill-formed; an
    operationalization bounded by nothing, or by a name that is no atom, primitive or concept; a
    name no table knows; an atom, measure, primitive or concept given the wrong number of
    arguments; an unbound variable, or one of the wrong sort where a track, region or device is
    read (such a position takes a variable, never a spelling or a number; a literal position
    takes no variable); a spelling no enumeration decodes; a quantifier kind that is not a
    spelling; a parameter of an atom or a call, or a window's length, that is not a constant
    term (a literal, a reading parameter, or arithmetic over them); a heading change's step bound
    that is not a literal or a reading parameter, or a literal one not strictly positive; a
    declared intention read ahead of the judged observation; the distance travelled since the trace began read inside a
    search into the past; a composed rule not in the set, or a map that names a variable not
    bound to a track, misses one of its binders or names one it does not have. `regions` names
    variables the caller binds to regions: the region formals of a concept's instance, which
    alone may then have no binder. -/
def check (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (regions : List String := []) : List String :=
  let scope : Scope := r.binderNames.map (fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)) ++ regions.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.region)
  let formed := if regions.isEmpty then r.wellFormed else r.wellFormedBody
  let reads (id : String) : Bool := match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | some r' => r'.readsIntention rules
    | none => false
  (if formed then [] else [s!"{r.id}: binders empty, duplicated or unnamed, an assumption, intention or concept undeclared, or an intention id ill-formed"]) ++
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => checkFormula [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (futureReads reads false) |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (pathReads (fun id => (rules.find? (·.id == id)).any (readsPath rules)) false)
    |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.compositions).flatMap (fun (id, map) =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => [s!"{r.id}: composes unknown rule `{id}`"]
    | some r' =>
      (map.filter (fun (inner, _) => !r'.binderNames.contains inner) |>.map fun (inner, _) => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` maps `{inner}`, not one of its binders") ++
      (r'.binderNames.filter (fun b => !map.any (·.1 == b)) |>.map fun b => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` leaves its binder `{b}` unmapped"))

/-- The aggregate ids `who` names that the reading does not declare, or whose declaration lists
    an id that is no road-user class. -/
def aggregateDefects (who : String) (ids : List String) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  ids.eraseDups.flatMap fun w =>
    match ρ.aggregate w with
    | none => [s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` is not declared by the reading"]
    | some a => (a.included ++ a.unresolved).filter (fun id => !id.startsWith "ru." || (RoadUserClass.ofString (id.drop 3).toString).isNone)
        |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` lists `{id}`, which is not a road-user class"

/-- Parameters and aggregates that the rule, or a rule it composes, names and the reading lacks,
    each rule read with its calls of the concepts `cs` expanded. -/
def checkReading (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (ρ : Reading) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
  (Rule.closure rules r).flatMap fun x =>
    let xx := Concept.expandRule cs x
    (xx.params.filter (!ρ.has ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{x.id}: parameter `{p}` is not in the reading")
    ++ aggregateDefects x.id (xx.formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds) ρ

end Rule

/-- Rule composition over a library, with fuel bounding the nesting depth. The composed rule's
    binders are bound through `map` (inner binder ↦ caller variable); an unmapped binder is an
    unbound variable, an unknown id is `compositionUnknown`. `engaged` selects the composed
    rule's applicability (for an exception or a condition) over its compliance. -/
def composeWith (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) :
    Nat → String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R
  | 0, id, _, _, _ => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
  | fuel + 1, id, map, β, engaged =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
    | some r =>
      let β' : Binding := ⟨map.filterMap fun (inner, outer) => (β.lookup outer).map fun v => (inner, v)⟩
      let c : Semantics.SemCtx := { d := d, β := β', compose := composeWith rules d fuel }
      if engaged then r.engagedAll c else r.asRAll c

/-- The evaluation context for a rule set over an indexed trace: composition resolves against
    `rules`, nested at most `rules.length` deep. -/
def Rule.context (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) (β : Binding) : Semantics.SemCtx :=
  { d := d, β := β, compose := composeWith rules d rules.length }

namespace Concept
open Semantics

-- Every concept call against the callee's signature: a track formal takes a variable bound to a
-- track, a region formal one bound to a region, a literal formal one of its admissible values, a
-- nat formal a number. Run on formulas whose own literal and nat formals already hold values.
mutual
  partial def termCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .quantity n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .measure _ _ | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ g ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
  partial def callDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .derived n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .cmp l _ r => termCallDefects cs scope where_ l ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ | .count φ ψ _ _ =>
      callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ | .atLast _ d _ φ ψ =>
      termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsRegion _ v φ | .forallRegion _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice _ v φ | .forallDevice _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | _ => []
  partial def callArgs (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ name : String) (args : List Arg) : List String :=
    match cs.find? (·.leanName == name) with
    | none => []
    | some c =>
      if args.length != c.args.length then []        -- an arity the expansion leaves for `Rule.check` to report
      else (c.args.zip args).filterMap fun ((n, so), a) =>
        let bad := some s!"{where_}: `{c.id}` formal `{n}` ({repr so}) is given {repr a}"
        match so, a with
        | .track, .var v => if scope.binds v .track then none else bad
        | .region, .var v => if scope.binds v .region then none else bad
        | .literal vs, .lit l => if vs.contains l then none else bad
        | .nat, .nat _ => none
        | _, _ => bad
end

/-- `callDefects` on a rule before expansion: each binder's class with that binder, the
    applicability and the obligation with every binder, all as tracks. -/
def ruleCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
  let scope : Rule.Scope := r.binderNames.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => callDefects cs [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation


/-- Every defect a concept has before any trace: an empty id; a formal or a parameter named
    twice; a parameter named as a reading's, or a body parameter that is no formal parameter; a
    literal formal that admits no value; a composed rule or a declared intention in the body (a
    concept reads neither); a referenced concept unknown, or a reference cycle; and, on every
    admissible instantiation of its literal formals with its calls expanded, every defect
    `Rule.check` finds in a formula and a call whose arguments do not fit the callee's formals. -/
def check (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
  let names := c.args.map (·.1)
  let pnames := c.paramNames
  let body := c.bodyFormula
  let structural :=
    (if c.id.isEmpty then ["concept: empty id"] else []) ++
    (if names.eraseDups.length != names.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal argument"] else []) ++
    (if pnames.eraseDups.length != pnames.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal parameter"] else []) ++
    (pnames.filter (·.contains '.') |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: parameter `{p}` names a reading parameter; a body references its formals only") ++
    (c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
      | .literal [] => some s!"{c.id}: literal formal `{n}` admits no value"
      | _ => none) ++
    ((Formula.params body).eraseDups.filter (!pnames.contains ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: `{p}` is not a formal parameter") ++
    ((Formula.composed body).map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept composes no rule (`{id}`)") ++
    ((Formula.intentions body).eraseDups.map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept reads no declared intention (`{id}`)") ++
    (c.refs.filter (fun n => !cs.any (·.leanName == n))
      |>.map fun n => s!"{c.id}: references unknown concept `{n}`") ++
    (if (onCycle cs).contains c.id then [s!"{c.id}: on a reference cycle"] else [])
  let scope : Rule.Scope := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
    | .track => some (n, EntityKind.track)
    | .region => some (n, EntityKind.region)
    | _ => none
  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
  let byInstance := (samples c).flatMap fun args =>
    match instantiate c args ps "check" with
    | none => [s!"{c.id}: arity"]
    | some b =>
      let φ := match b with | .formula φ => φ | .quantity t => Formula.cmp t .eq t
      let φx := expand cs φ
      callDefects cs scope c.id φ ++ Rule.checkFormula scope c.id φx ++
        (Rule.pathReads (fun _ => false) false φx).map fun e => s!"{c.id}: {e}"
  structural ++ byInstance.eraseDups

/-- The aggregates a concept's body names, its calls expanded, that the reading does not declare
    or declares with an id that is no road-user class. -/
def checkReading (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  Rule.aggregateDefects c.id (aggregateIds cs c) ρ

end Concept

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
3	  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.
4	
5	  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
6	  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
7	  drop them once a value is decided.
8	-/
9	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
10	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
11	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles
12	
13	namespace TrafficSpec
14	
15	inductive UnknownReason
16	  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
17	  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
18	  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
19	  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
20	  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
21	  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
22	  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
23	  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
24	  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
25	  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
26	  | divisionByZero (what : String)
27	  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
28	  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
29	  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	namespace UnknownReason
33	/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
34	def tag : UnknownReason → String
35	  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
36	  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
37	  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
38	  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
39	  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
40	  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
41	  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
42	  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
43	  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
44	  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
45	  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
46	  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
47	  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
48	  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
49	instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
50	end UnknownReason
51	
52	/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
53	structure R where
54	  v : Tri
55	  why : List UnknownReason := []
56	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
57	
58	namespace R
59	def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
60	def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
61	def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
62	def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
63	def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
64	  match o with
65	  | some b => ofBool b
66	  | none => u w
67	/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
68	def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
69	@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
70	def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
71	def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
72	def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
73	@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
74	@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
75	@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
76	def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
77	def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
78	def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
79	/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
80	def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
81	  match o with
82	  | some a => k a
83	  | none => u w
84	end R
85	
86	/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
87	abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q
88	
89	/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
90	    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
91	structure RangeAgg where
92	  vals : Array R
93	  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
94	  prefT : Array Nat
95	  prefU : Array Nat
96	  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)
97	
98	namespace RangeAgg
99	def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
100	  let n := vals.size
101	  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
102	    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
103	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
104	    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
105	  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩
106	
107	private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
108	private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
109	  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
110	  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []
111	
112	/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
113	def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
114	  if hi < lo then R.t
115	  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
116	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
117	  else R.t
118	/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
119	def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
120	  if hi < lo then R.f
121	  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
122	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
123	  else R.f
124	
125	/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
126	def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
127	  | 0 => 0
128	  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)
129	
130	private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
131	    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
132	    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
133	      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
134	  induction k with
135	  | zero => simp [countTo]
136	  | succ k ih =>
137	    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
138	    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
139	    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
140	    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
141	    split
142	    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
143	    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
144	      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]
145	
146	theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
147	    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
148	  induction b with
149	  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
150	  | succ b ih =>
151	    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
152	    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
153	    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
154	      exact Nat.le_refl _
155	
156	/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
157	theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
158	    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
159	  constructor
160	  · intro h
161	    induction n with
162	    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
163	    | succ n ih =>
164	      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
165	      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
166	        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
167	        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
168	      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
169	        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
170	        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
171	  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
172	    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
173	    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
174	    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
175	    omega
176	
177	private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
178	    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
179	  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
180	  simp only [cnt, build]
181	  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]
182	
183	/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
184	theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
185	    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
186	  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
187	    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
188	    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
189	    exact absurd h (by decide)
190	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
191	    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
192	    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
193	    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
194	  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
195	    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
196	    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
197	    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
198	      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
199	      rw [hf.1]; omega
200	    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
201	    omega
202	  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
203	  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
204	  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩
205	
206	/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
207	theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
208	    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
209	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
210	    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
211	    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
212	    omega
213	  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
214	end RangeAgg

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
  drop them once a value is decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason
  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

namespace RangeAgg
def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size
  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TRAINING SPLIT of TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms. Generated from Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean by

6	/-
7	  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
8	  The bijection with the atoms of ATOMS.md: exactly one definition per atom id, named `family_name`,
9	  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the
10	  atom's name plus a suffix (`dev_traffic_signal_shows`, `ru_rider_posture_on_seat`).
11	
12	  Rules of this file, held by the doctor:
13	  - every `\`family.name\`` in ATOMS.md has exactly one `def family_name` here and vice versa;
14	  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's
15	    or a derived concept's business;
16	  - the `rel_*` atoms may compute geometry from kinematics, because their contract says they are
17	    "computed from kinematics; listed because a source may supply them measured" — a measured
18	    value, when the source gives one, is preferred; `rel_visible` reads a measured value only.
19	
20	  Every atom is three-valued: `none` is "not observed on this source".
21	-/
22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	
27	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
29	-- square root at micrometre resolution).
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	namespace Geom
32	def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
33	def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
34	def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
35	/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
36	def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
57	/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
64	  let ab := vsub b a
65	  let ap := vsub p a
66	  let l2 := normSq ab
67	  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
68	  else
69	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
70	    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
71	/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
72	def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
73	  let n := poly.length
74	  if n < 3 then false
75	  else
76	    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
77	    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
78	      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
79	      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
80	        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
81	        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
82	         !Q.isZero dy &&
83	         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
84	    crossings.length % 2 == 1
85	/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
86	def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
87	  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
88	  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
89	/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
90	def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
91	  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
92	/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
93	def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
94	  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
95	  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
96	    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
97	/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
98	def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
99	  let n := poly.length
100	  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
101	/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
102	    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
103	def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
104	  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
105	    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
106	/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
107	def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
108	  match poly with
109	  | [] => none
110	  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
111	  | _ =>
112	    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
113	    else
114	      let n := poly.length
115	      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
116	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
117	/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
118	def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
119	  let ab := vsub b a
120	  let l2 := normSq ab
121	  if Q.isZero l2 then a
122	  else
123	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
124	    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
125	/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
126	def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
127	  match poly with
128	  | [] => none
129	  | [a] => some a
130	  | _ =>
131	    let n := poly.length
132	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
133	    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
134	      | none => some c
135	      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
136	/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
137	    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
138	def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
139	  match poly with
140	  | [] => []
141	  | [a] => [a]
142	  | _ =>
143	    let n := poly.length
144	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
145	    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
146	    | [] => []
147	    | d :: ds =>
148	      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
149	      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

522	-- Environment
523	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
524	def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness

528	def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility

531	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532	-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
533	-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
534	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d
538	  | none => do
539	    let pa ← kin_position s a
540	    let pb ← kin_position s b
541	    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))
542	
543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false
587	def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a
589	
590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))
606	
607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)
622	
623	/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633	
634	/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643	
644	/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
646	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero
649	
650	/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)
652	
653	end TrafficSpec
